slides.body: Sunday, Oct. 25 at 1 p.m. at ICA Miami Expansion Space in Miami. Tickets are $50 for adults and $15 for kids. It includes mural-focused art expeditions, hands-on stations and a 40-minute Fantasy Theatre performance.
